simple_explanation: Your blood pressure is too high at 158/94. Normal blood pressure is less than 120/80. High blood pressure makes your heart work harder and can damage your blood vessels over time. We call this condition hypertension.
important_instructions: Take lisinopril 10 mg every morning. Limit salt in your diet to less than 2300 mg per day (about 1 teaspoon). Exercise for at least 30 minutes most days. Lose weight if you're overweight. Check your blood pressure at home twice a week.
medication_guidance: Lisinopril relaxes your blood vessels to lower blood pressure. Take it at the same time each day, even if you feel fine. Don't stop taking it suddenly. You might feel dizzy when standing up at first - this usually gets better. Call us if you develop a dry cough.
follow_up: Return in 4 weeks to check how well the medication is working. We'll measure your blood pressure and adjust the dose if needed. Bring your home blood pressure readings to show us.
